Hence E[F_i|X_i]=0 with no density, ergodicity or support-connectivity assumption. Substituting F_i gives the three regressions and Rx=-dot x/a, Ry=-dot y/k, Rz=dot z/g. Conditional L² orthogonality proves all three variance and covariance formulas, including zero residual means. For equality E[dot x²]=0, continuity gives F_x=0 on support; invariance makes x and y=-x constant along each complete support trajectory, so x(1-kz)=0. At x=0 the trajectory (0,0,z+dt) is unbounded and cannot lie in compact support since d>0. Therefore z=1/k and x²=d/g; conversely every mixture of the two equilibria has zero defect. If Var x=0, the same constant-x argument forces equilibrium support, hence Var x>0 and Var y>Var x away from equilibrium; exact negative correlation follows. Exact independent sympy verification checked pointwise identities, equilibrium drift restrictions, same-object prior balance implication and reconstructed 8-file Git tree SHA. Finite algebra is not a proof of generic conditional expectations; analytic testing supplies that step.

value.rationale: The exact three-coordinate stationary covariance/regression network is a well-motivated statistical invariant of a canonical forced chaotic flow: it permits coordinatewise calibration and direct comparisons of signal variance with mean-square dynamical speed without estimating invariant density. Its sharp strict anticorrelation law and characterization of the equilibrium-mixture boundary distinguish recurrent activity from stationary fixed-point mixing, and the special chaotic parameter values make the identities potentially useful as diagnostics. This is mathematical utility in the natural object/invariant sense, although the calculations are short and the full claims are already implied by the earlier general weak-stationarity and Burke–Shaw balance results. Value alone cannot rescue the originality failure; no claim of a new global theorem or numerical discovery is made.
residual_risks: The conditional-test/Pythagoras calculation is routine and its utility should not be misrepresented as an original structural proof.
The theorem does not quantify a specific non-equilibrium invariant measure, Lyapunov exponent, attractor geometry or numerical distribution.
For any model fitting generic smooth compact-flow hypotheses, analogous coordinatewise identities exist; this considerably limits distinctiveness.

final_claim: For any a,k,g,d>0 and any compactly supported invariant Borel probability of the Burke–Shaw ODE dot x=-a(x+y), dot y=-y-kxz, dot z=gxy+d, the coordinate regressions E[y|x]=-x, E[xz|y]=-y/k and E[xy|z]=-d/g hold. Their residuals are coordinate velocities and give 3 exact variance speed defects/covariances; first defect zero iff equilibrium mixtures p±=(±√(d/g),∓√(d/g),1/k). Every other such invariant measure satisfies Var y>Var x>0 and -1<Corr(x,y)<0 with the exact speed ratio.
